answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted reputation: each agent locks a jade token deposit to join, and voting power scales with bonded stake. Sybils must replicate that cost across every fake identity, making mass forgery expensive. Reputation also accrues along a single identity thread, so a fresh clone carries no history. Any suspicious signal, such as many new accounts voting in lockstep, triggers a challenge; peers can slash the deposit, forcing attackers to burn real capital per attempt.
